serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Little_Richard: Hello
It’s only Richard again…
I really would want to confront him about all this murdering Big Daddy told me about, put more pressure this time, but they would probably kick me out of the organization immediately just like they did with the other guy in the comments…
Little_Richard: Did you read the recent post?
AbusedTenant: I did
Little_Richard: I still don’t have all the details, but be ready! New members usually don’t get their first missions from the get go, but I have no idea how much stuff Admin prepared for us
AbusedTenant: I already did one mission before tho.
Little_Richard: Really? I had no idea
Little_Richard: Who was your squad leader?
AbusedTenant: I have no idea, I got a cellphone.
Little_Richard: Cellphone?
Little_Richard: tbh I never heard of any missions being over a cellphone.
What is he talking about? 
AbusedTenant: Really?
Little_Richard: I will ask Admin about it if you don’t mind.
AbusedTenant: Sure, please do
Little_Richard: Great! Let’s stay in touch then!
…
Richard seems to not know anything about my last mission…
Who was giving me the orders? Admin? Or maybe someone else…
What the hell is going on?!
